emily: saw two OOMs on shard-12 during long sessions, attaching quick heap summary.
rahul: profiler summary—~25% retained by obsolete KV tombstones, hotspot scorer::hold_lease.
jun: reproduced in staging with long-chat-sim. command: ./tools/long_chat_sim --duration 45m --inserts 50k
emily: short action items: 
  1) rahul -> implement opt-in weak lease + default TTL=600s, target 2026-04-05
  2) jun -> add growth-triggered heap-snapshot job (trigger: +40MB in 3m), target 2026-04-04
  3) infra -> add eviction alert (warn 75%, crit 90%), owner=sre-bot, target 2026-04-03
rahul: plan: feature flag scorer.lease_weak=true; unit tests + 24h staging soak. I'll post PR link when ready.
jun: will add CI reproducer and the snapshot webhook to runbook.
sre-bot: alert rule created: kv_tombstone_pressure (warn 75%, crit 90%).
emily: note: measure cache hit-rate before enabling TTL. aggressive TTLs hurt p99.
rahul: preliminary estimate TTL=10m reduces retained by ~15% on sampled traces.
emily: scheduling 20m sync tomorrow 9:30am PST to review PR and first snapshots. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
